enabled.label: Sandbox mode
enabled.description: Capture outgoing mail instead of sending it.

recipientPolicy.label: Sandbox recipient policy
recipientPolicy.description: How sandbox handles recipients: allow, rewrite, drop, or capture.

authResults.label: Inbound auth results
authResults.description: Include SPF, DKIM, DMARC and ARC results on received messages.

archiveRaw.label: Archive raw inbound mail
archiveRaw.description: Store the raw source of every new message in S3.

replyText.label: Reply text extraction
replyText.description: Allow reply-text extraction when the endpoint opts in.

bounceDetection.label: Bounce detection
bounceDetection.description: Classify bounces, ARF reports and auto-replies.

qresync.label: QRESYNC sync
qresync.description: Use QRESYNC change detection when the mail server offers it.

enabled.label: Protocol logs
enabled.description: Keep per-account IMAP and SMTP transcripts.

rawDebug.label: Protocol raw debug
rawDebug.description: Log full protocol bytes (turns off automatically after a TTL).

mode.label: Webhook signature mode
mode.description: Choose standard or body-only webhook signatures.

perEndpoint.label: Per-endpoint webhook secrets
perEndpoint.description: Use a separate signing secret for each webhook endpoint.

rotationOverlap.label: Webhook secret rotation overlap
rotationOverlap.description: Dual-sign webhooks while a secret is rotating.

mtls.label: Webhook mTLS
mtls.description: Require a client certificate when delivering webhooks.

blockPrivate.label: Block private webhook egress
blockPrivate.description: Block delivery to private, ULA, or loopback addresses.

totp.label: TOTP MFA
totp.description: Allow time-based one-time passwords for MFA.

emailOtp.label: Email OTP MFA
emailOtp.description: Allow email one-time passwords for MFA (needs system mail).

oidc.label: OIDC SSO
oidc.description: Allow OIDC single sign-on for the organisation.

accountBound.label: Account-bound API keys
accountBound.description: Allow API keys bound to a single account.

enabled.label: Config as code
enabled.description: Enable YAML plan and apply via CLI and API.

webSafeHtml.label: Safe HTML in payloads
webSafeHtml.description: Allow sanitised HTML in message payloads when the endpoint opts in.

calendarEvents.label: Calendar events in payloads
calendarEvents.description: Allow parsed iCalendar data in payloads when the endpoint opts in.

s3.label: Attachments in S3
s3.description: Store attachments in S3 and serve signed URLs.

antivirus.label: Attachment antivirus
antivirus.description: Scan attachments with ClamAV before delivery.

throttle.label: Send throttling
throttle.description: Throttle sending per provider and per domain.

preSendHook.label: Pre-send policy hook
preSendHook.description: Run a policy hook before each send.

tokenExport.label: OAuth token export
tokenExport.description: Allow exporting the account OAuth token via the API.

authServer.label: External credential server
authServer.description: Fetch credentials from an external auth server.

hostedPage.label: Hosted connect page
hostedPage.description: Enable the hosted mailbox connect page.

msa.label: SMTP submission server
msa.description: Run the SMTP mail submission agent.

embeddings.label: Semantic search
embeddings.description: Find mail by meaning and ask questions about a mailbox, with the embeddings endpoint of the AI settings. Needs full-text search. Accounts can opt out.

slack.label: Slack integration
slack.description: Enable the Slack incoming webhook connector.

rspamd.label: Rspamd integration
rspamd.description: Enable the Rspamd spam scoring connector.

teams.label: Microsoft Teams integration
teams.description: Enable the Microsoft Teams webhook connector.

telegram.label: Telegram integration
telegram.description: Enable the Telegram Bot API connector.

helpdesk.label: Helpdesk integration
helpdesk.description: Enable the generic helpdesk webhook connector.

ses.label: Amazon SES integration
ses.description: Enable the Amazon SES sending connector.

gdrive.label: Google Drive integration
gdrive.description: Enable the Google Drive storage connector.

sso-entra.label: Microsoft Entra ID SSO
sso-entra.description: Enable the Microsoft Entra ID SSO preset.

sso-google.label: Google Workspace SSO
sso-google.description: Enable the Google Workspace SSO preset.

enabled.label: PEC
enabled.description: Enable the PEC module for the account.

evidenceArchive.label: PEC evidence archive
evidenceArchive.description: Archive PEC receipts and envelopes with Object Lock.

nats.label: NATS sink
nats.description: Make the NATS event sink available.

kafka.label: Kafka sink
kafka.description: Make the Kafka event sink available.

sqs.label: Amazon SQS sink
sqs.description: Make the Amazon SQS event sink available.

sns.label: Amazon SNS sink
sns.description: Make the Amazon SNS event sink available.

pubsub.label: Pub/Sub sink
pubsub.description: Make the Google Pub/Sub event sink available.

fullText.label: Full-text search
fullText.description: Index the text of every message so the Search page finds mail across all accounts. Accounts can opt out.
